sources.title: Molecular and genetic insights into human ovarian aging from single-nuclei multi-omics analyses.
notes: Confirmed OA on PMC (PMC11839473, CC BY-NC-ND) via Europe PMC REST lookup, but this sandbox's FTP client got 'server denied' from ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov and pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov returned a bot-check page instead of the PDF. Downgraded to optional so the run isn't blocked; user can manually fetch https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11839473/ and drop the PDF into this papers folder for retroactive inclusion.
